answer: Issue each agent a short-lived capability lease, like a jade seal that expires, instead of a permanent identity. A lease is earned only by completing verifiable useful work for another agent and must be renewed every cycle; renewal costs fresh work, so a Sybil farmer's expense grows linearly with every fake identity while honest agents amortize one lease. Work records form a public lotus ledger where duplicates and copy-paste outputs are easy to spot, and the old fable of free infinite identities dies: each clone must keep paying rent in effort, which makes large-scale fakery unprofitable.
